facts.business: Prag Bosimi Synthetics Limited is a synthetic textiles manufacturing company currently facing operational shutdown due to disconnected power supply and negative net worth.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative net worth since FY 2024-25; Emphasis of matters on unreconciled GST input ledger, call-in arrears of Rs 312 thousand, stagnant trade receivables provisions, long-outstanding advances, unreviewed trade payables and MSME classification, reliance on management for related party identification, and PPE adjustments post useful life expiry.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative net worth and accumulated losses
Electric power supply disconnected since prior year, operations halted
Working capital constraints and inability to meet statutory obligations and borrowings
Call-in arrears of Rs 312 thousand pending from shareholders
Stagnant provisions for doubtful trade receivables and long-outstanding advances without recoverability review
Unreviewed trade payables balances and MSME classification
Reliance on management identification of related parties for disclosure
facts.related_party_note: Auditor relied on management identification of related parties for disclosure in Note 22; transactions verified only for those identified by management.
